items.description: Manchester City's slick footballing machine is starting to grind to a halt, as displayed in their laborious Champions League draw against Napoli.

items.title: Real Madrid top CL table as Bellingham scores stunner in thumping PSV win
Poch cites Eze as he questions Barcola role in Szoboszlai goal - is he right?
items.description: Speaking ahead of his side's clash against Sporting Lisbon, Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino questioned Bradley Barcola's impact on Dominik Szoboszlai's freekick goal and made a comparison to Eberechi Eze's disallowed attempt from 2025.

items.title: Pochettino leads Man Utd fury at Yoro red card ruling
items.description: Manchester United and Mauricio Pochettino are furious at how Leny Yoro's red card has been handled by VAR John Brooks and referees' chief Howard Webb

items.title: Wasteful Arsenal held by Borussia Dortmund
items.description: Arsenal were punished for failing to take their chances for the second game in a row as Maximilian Beier clinched a 1-1 draw for Borussia Dortmund in the Champions League.

items.title: Poch fumes at Yoro red and thinks Szoboszlai goal shouldn't have stood
items.description: Mauricio Pochettino has heavily criticised VAR in Manchester United's loss at Liverpool after Leny Yoro's red card was overturned, while the Argentine believes Dominik Szoboszlai’s opener should not have stood.

items.title: Parker still winless as Portsmouth beat West Ham
items.description: Scott Parker's winless start to life as West Ham boss continued as Odin Bailey netted his first Portsmouth goal in a 1-0 victory at Fratton Park.

items.title: Lankshear steers Boro back to the top of the Championship
items.description: Will Lankshear was back among the goals as Middlesbrough cemented their position at the top of the Championship with a 2-1 win over Swansea City.

items.title: Oxford beat Spurs U21s to seal EFL Trophy progress
items.description: Aaron Ramsey's Oxford United beat Tottenham Under-21s to secure one of the final two Jersey Mike's Trophy knockout spots.

items.title: Man Utd target Collins - Wednesday's gossip
items.description: Manchester United target Brentford defender Nathan Collins, Bournemouth price forward Eli Junior Kroupi at £100m and Liverpool close in on new Rio Ngumoha contract.
